# Calculate the time range for each wrestler in years
# Assuming 'first' and 'last' columns are strings in the format "month year"
# Convert to datetime, but only year is needed for range calculation
df['first_year'] = pd.to_datetime(df['first'], format='%B %Y', errors='coerce').dt.year
df['last_year'] = pd.to_datetime(df['last'], format='%B %Y', errors='coerce').dt.year
df['range_years'] = df['last_year'] - df['first_year']

# Find the minimum range
min_range = df['range_years'].min()

# Check if takamiyama has the minimum range
takamiyama_range = df.loc[df['name'] == 'takamiyama', 'range_years'].iloc[0]

# The claim: takamiyama had the shortest time range, 13 years
# Check both that takamiyama's range is the minimum and that it equals 13
answer = (takamiyama_range == min_range) and (takamiyama_range == 13)
